category_title: Highly anxious or extremely shy students at risk of disengagement
minimal_context: The student is at the playground during lunch break, expected to wait in line and take turns playing 4-square handball with her peers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright, it is time for 4-square handball. Go ahead and line up to wait your turn to get into a square.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands far away from the court, looking down and avoiding the group of nine students waiting in line) ...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to join the line with the others.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Steps further back, refusing to look at the kids her own age) I don't want to go over there.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just go stand with them and wait.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns her back to the court, completely shutting down and refusing to participate) No. I can't speak to them.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Alright, it is time for 4-square handball. Go ahead and line up to wait your turn to get into a square.

STUDENT: (Stands far away from the court, looking down and avoiding the group of nine students waiting in line) ...

TUTOR: You need to join the line with the others.

STUDENT: (Steps further back, refusing to look at the kids her own age) I don't want to go over there.

TUTOR: Just go stand with them and wait.

STUDENT: (Turns her back to the court, completely shutting down and refusing to participate) No. I can't speak to them.

task.content: Participating in a lunchtime 4-square handball session
task.learning_goal: Following the agreed rules, supervised by the teacher aide and visiting players, and learning to respectfully take turns

context.social_setting: Up to nine students waiting their turn to get into a square, supervised by the teacher aide and visiting players

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When up to nine students would need to wait their turn to get into a square
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Struggling socially with things like that, fail to regulate their behaviour

behavior_patterns.condition: When required to wait their turn or interact in unstructured social settings
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Struggled to even speak to kids her own age, struggling socially
